titulo: Terms and conditions of being my friend
caption:
Terms and conditions of being my friend. Read carefully.
Send it to someone. If they accept, you’re in.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#friendship #friends #relatable

alt.1: Cella in a crown under a spotlight next to a big yellow contract. Send to a friend · 5 terms. Terms and conditions of being my friend. Read carefully. Accept anyway.
alt.2: a big number 1 and a small Cella in the corner. Gorgeously. It's in the terms. Check 1. I will be late.
alt.3: a big number 2 and a small Cella in the corner. All four minutes. By Thursday. Check 2. I read your voice notes.
alt.4: a big number 3 and a small Cella in the corner. Gently. Then I remind you I was right. Check 3. I tell you the truth.
alt.5: a big number 4 and a small Cella in the corner. With snacks. No advice unless you ask. Check 4. I show up when it's bad.
alt.6: a big number 5 and a small Cella in the corner. Once. Kindly. I'll sulk, then thank you. Check 5. You tell me when I'm wrong.
alt.7: the five terms as a list and a signature line. Sign here. Accepted by: Send it to a friend. They accept, you're in. 1. Late, gorgeously 2. Voice notes by Thursday 3. Truth, gently 4. Snacks, no advice 5. Tell me I'm wrong.

experimento_prueba: Contrato para mandar: términos y condiciones de ser amigo de Cella. Prueba si 'acepta o no' se manda a un amigo más que una lista para guardar.
